firstPlayerRule: Deal one card face up to each player; the lowest card deals. The player to the left of the dealer goes first.
houseFallback: If players tie for the lowest card, deal those players another card.
clarifications: A player keeps the turn while they keep catching the rank they asked for.

sources.title: Go Fish — How to Play
sources.publisher: Bicycle Cards (The United States Playing Card Company)

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards Go Fish page in a browser. "The Deal": "Any player deals one card face up to each player. The player with the lowest card is the dealer." "The Play": "The player to the left of the dealer looks directly at any opponent and says, for example, ‘Give me your kings’".
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for the lowest card.
